pdk: GT3 open-source 3nm GAAFET (Naeemi/GaTech), BSIM-CMG level 72 / VERSION 111.2.1, GEOMOD=5 nanosheet
toolchain: ngspice-42 + OSDI; BSIM-CMG (VA-Models latest vacode, GAA-capable) compiled with OpenVAF 22.12; GT3 cards mapped nmos/pmos->bsimcmg_va, TYPE=+1/-1 (DEVTYPE ignored), N-prefix instances
inverter: 1x nmos + 2x pmos, default geometry, same for rvt and lvt
flavors: GT3 ships rvt (regular) and lvt (low); both apply to nmos and pmos symmetrically

constants.note: low-Vt buys ~17% speed for ~13x leakage and ZERO dynamic-energy benefit (rvt~lvt dynamic) -> pure critical-path speed tool at 3nm, even more one-sided than sky130

vs_sky130.takeaway: constants do NOT carry across nodes; each node re-anchors its own. Vt speedup similar, leakage RATIO smaller but absolute leakage far higher, no low-Vt energy upside.
